components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-primary-container, #06b6d4); color: var(--color-on-primary-container, #00424f); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #4cd7f6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Bordered panel action button for filters, pagination, and secondary links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-surface-panel, #111827); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #94a3b8); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #1e293b); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-highlight, #334155); color: var(--color-text-primary, #f8fafc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #4cd7f6); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Idraak Lab is built like a high-precision Arabic engineering instrument: deep midnight-navy surfaces, crisp cyan and emerald telemetry signals, and tabular numbers that let AI developers scan latency, tokenization efficiency, and cost without visual noise. Every surface is designed RTL-first (dir="rtl", lang="ar") in dark mode by default, with a calibrated opt-in light mode that preserves contrast and surface separation.

The visual language is crisp, technical, and restrained. It rejects generic SaaS purple-pink gradients, decorative card-in-card clutter, and low-contrast gray-on-colored text that slows down benchmark comparison.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first Midnight Slate canvas (#0b1326 / #06090e) paired with a tinted Ice Slate light mode (#e8eef7) so cards always separate from the page.
High-legibility Arabic sans-serif (IBM Plex Sans Arabic) paired with JetBrains Mono for benchmark metrics, prices, and telemetry strips.
Tonal surface layering and 1px hairline borders (#1e293b) instead of heavy drop shadows.
Distinct per-metric color coding so speed, Arabic efficiency, cost, and latency scan instantaneously across tables.

rules.name: The Metric Hue Rule
rules.body: Speed (#06b6d4), Arabic Efficiency (#10b981), Cost (#f59e0b), and Latency (#ec4899) each own one dedicated hue. Never reuse metric hues for decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Legible Canvas Rule
rules.body: Never place muted gray text on saturated or dark-tinted containers without verifying contrast; light mode darkens all accents to WCAG-safe shades.

rules.name: The Monospace Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All numerical benchmark scores, latencies, token counts, and API prices render in JetBrains Mono so columns align cleanly across rows.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest in dark mode, separated by tonal contrast and 1px hairline borders rather than drop shadows.

dos: Do design every layout RTL-first (dir="rtl") and verify both dark (default) and opt-in light mode contrast.
Do use JetBrains Mono for all numerical metrics, latencies, prices, and telemetry strips.
Do separate adjacent surfaces with tonal steps and 1px Border Subtle hairlines.
Do preserve dedicated metric hues (Speed, Efficiency, Cost, Latency) consistently across tables and charts.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS purple-pink gradients or decorative card-in-card nesting.
Don't place low-contrast gray text on colored backgrounds where it slows down tabular scanning.
Don't add bouncy spring animations or heavy drop shadows to data cards.
Don't hardcode dark-only hex colors in views when a semantic token (bg-surface-panel, text-text-primary, border-border-subtle) exists.
